name: National Aluminium Company Ltd
title: National Aluminium Company Ltd - 532234 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: NALCO guides FY27 alumina to 25 lakh tonnes on a 2 lakh tonne fifth stream, but expects alumina at $300-310/t vs $376 in FY26, with metal near $3,000-3,100/t offsetting; capex steps up to Rs4,000-5,000 crore in FY28.

capex.peers_comment: Indonesia refinery capacity additions and Middle East smelter curtailments cited as alumina oversupply drivers; no explicit peer capex comment.
capex.quote: Capex will be around Rs.4,000 crores. This year we are targeting around Rs.1,800 crores to Rs.2,000

triggers.quote: the prices will further go down. The prices of alumina, which is average was Rs.376 last year

triggers.label: Alumina excess from Indonesia refineries
triggers.quote: There will be an excess of alumina in the market every time this year or maybe next year.

triggers.quote: Aluminium average realization, which currently which we are getting is around Rs.3,600 LME hovering.
